name: foundry-specimen-sheet
title: Foundry Specimen Sheet
description: A variable-font specimen: one phrase rendered at descending sizes and weights in a strict table, with a live weight axis slider that re-renders every row — how type foundries actually present a cut.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Axis Slider: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
